definitions: The slow movement of the axis of a spinning body around another axis due to a torque.
The slow gyration of the Earth's axis, causing the equinoxes to occur earlier each year.
The act of preceding or going in front.
examples: The precession of the equinoxes is a well-known astronomical phenomenon.
The gyroscope demonstrated the principle of precession.
We observed the precession of the planets in their orbits.
